description_en: Submits a serverless job to an Elastic High Performance Computing (E-HPC) cluster
kebab_example: aliyun ehpc submit-serverless-job --cluster-id ehpc-hz-FYUr320000 --job-name testjob --container '{"WorkingDir":"/usr/local/","Command":["python3"],"Arg":["hello.py"],"VolumeMount":[{}],"Image":"registry-vpc.cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/ehpc/hpl:latest","Gpu":1,"EnvironmentVar":[{}]}' --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitServerlessJob

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html operation to query the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html获取集群ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the serverless job.

The name can contain lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-). It cannot start or end with a hyphen
parameters.help_zh:
Serverless作业名。
支持英文小写字母、数字或者短划线（-），不能以短划线开头或者结尾
parameters.name: job_name

fields.help_en: The end value of the array job index. Valid values: 0 to 4999. The value must be greater than or equal to the value of IndexStart
fields.help_zh: 数组作业索引的结束值。取值范围：0~4999，且大于等于IndexStart
fields.name: index_end

fields.help_en: The starting value of the array job index. Valid values: 0 to 4999
fields.help_zh: 数组作业索引的起始值。取值范围：0~4999
fields.name: index_start

fields.help_en:
The interval of the array job index.

If the array job property is IndexStart=1,IndexEnd=5, and IndexStep=2, the array job contains three subtasks. The values of the subtask indexes are 1,3, and 5
fields.help_zh:
数组作业索引的间隔。
若数组作业属性为IndexStart=1,IndexEnd=5,IndexStep=2，则该数组作业包含三个子任务，子任务索引分别为1,3,5
fields.name: index_step

parameters.help_en:
The configuration of the array job.

The value of an array job index is passed to a serverless job container through the environment variable `EHPC_ARRAY_TASK_ID`. Users can access the container from business programs
parameters.help_zh:
数组作业配置。
数组作业索引值会通过环境变量`EHPC_ARRAY_TASK_ID`传入Serverless作业容器中，支持用户业务程序访问
parameters.name: array_properties

parameters.help_en: The scheduling priority of the serverless job. Valid values: 0 to 999. A greater value indicates a higher priority
parameters.help_zh: Serverless作业的调度优先级。取值范围：0~999，取值越大，优先级越高
parameters.name: job_priority

parameters.help_en:
The size of the temporary storage space added to the serverless job container. Unit: GiB.

By default, a space of 30 GiB is provided free of charge. If you require a larger space, you can pass this parameter to specify your required space size
parameters.help_zh:
为Serverless作业容器增加的临时存储空间大小。单位：GiB。
Serverless作业容器默认提供30 GiB的免费存储空间，如果您的存储需求大于30 GiB，可以通过该参数自定义增加临时存储空间大小
parameters.name: ephemeral_storage

parameters.help_en: The validity period of the serverless job. After the validity period expires, the job is forcibly terminated. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: Serverless作业的有效期限，超出该时间后，作业会强制终止。单位为秒
parameters.name: timeout

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the vSwitches to which the serverless job container belongs
parameters.help_zh: Serverless作业容器所属的交换机ID列表
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance types used by the serverless job container
parameters.help_zh: Serverless作业容器所采用的ECS实例规格列表
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en: The vCPU size of the serverless job container. Unit: cores
parameters.help_zh: Serverless作业容器的vCPU大小。单位：核
parameters.name: cpu

parameters.help_en: The memory size of the serverless job container. Unit: GiB
parameters.help_zh: Serverless作业容器的内存大小。单位：GiB
parameters.name: memory

parameters.help_en:
The bidding policy of the ECS instances. Valid values:

NoSpot: The instance is created as a pay-as-you-go instance.
SpotWithPriceLimit: The instance is created as a preemptible instance for which you specify the maximum hourly price.
SpotAsPriceGo: The instance is created as a preemptible instance for which the market price at the time of purchase is automatically used as the bid price.

Default value: NoSpot
parameters.help_zh:
实例的抢占策略。取值范围：

NoSpot：正常按量付费实例。
SpotWithPriceLimit：设置上限价格的抢占式实例。
SpotAsPriceGo：系统自动出价，跟随当前市场实际价格的抢占式实例。

默认值：NoSpot
parameters.name: spot_strategy

parameters.help_en:
The maximum hourly price of the preemptible elastic container instance. The value can be accurate to three decimal places.

If you set SpotStrategy to SpotWithPriceLimit, you must specify the SpotPriceLimit parameter
parameters.help_zh:
设置抢占式实例的每小时最高价格，最多精确到小数点后3位。

当SpotStrategy取值为SpotWithPriceLimit时，必须设置SpotPriceLimit
parameters.name: spot_price_limit

parameters.help_en: The Resource Access Manamement (RAM) role that is associated with the Serverless job container
parameters.help_zh: Serverless作业容器绑定的RAM角色名称
parameters.name: ram_role_name

fields.help_en: The arguments of the container startup command. You can specify up to 10 arguments
fields.help_zh: 容器启动命令对应的参数列表。最多10个
fields.name: arg

fields.help_en: The container startup commands
fields.help_zh: 容器启动指令列表
fields.name: command

fields.help_en: The name of the environment variable for the container. The name can be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and underscores (_). The name cannot start with a digit. Specify the name in the [0-9a-zA-Z] format
fields.help_zh: 环境变量名。长度为1~128位。格式要求：[0-9a-zA-Z]，以及下划线，不能以数字开头
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The value of the environment variable for the container. The value must be 0 to 256 bits in length
fields.help_zh: 环境变量值。长度为0~256位
fields.name: value

fields.help_en: The value of the environment variable for the container
fields.help_zh: 容器的环境变量值
fields.name: environment_var

fields.help_en: The number of GPUs used by the container
fields.help_zh: 容器使用的GPU个数
fields.name: gpu

fields.help_en: The container image
fields.help_zh: 容器镜像
fields.name: image

fields.help_en:
The driver type when you use the FlexVolume plug-in to mount a volume. Valid values:

alicloud/nas: a NAS driver.
alicloud/oss: an OSS driver
fields.help_zh:
使用FlexVolume插件挂载数据卷时的驱动类型。取值范围如下：

alicloud/nas：挂载NAS。

alicloud/oss：挂载OSS
fields.name: flex_volume_driver

fields.help_en: The options of the FlexVolume object. Each option is a key-value pair in a JSON string
fields.help_zh: FlexVolume对象选项列表。为KV形式，采用JSON传递
fields.name: flex_volume_options

fields.help_en:
The directory to which the volume is mounted.

The data stored in this directory is overwritten by the data on the volume. Exercise caution when you specify this parameter
fields.help_zh:
容器挂载数据卷的目录。    

容器挂载目录下的内容会被Volume的内容直接覆盖，请谨慎使用
fields.name: mount_path

fields.help_en: The data volumes that are mounted to the container
fields.help_zh: 容器挂载的数据卷列表
fields.name: volume_mount

fields.help_en: The working directory of the container
fields.help_zh: 容器工作目录
fields.name: working_dir

parameters.help_en: The properties of the Serverless job container
parameters.name: container

fields.help_en: The ID of the dependent job
fields.help_zh: 所依赖的作业ID
fields.name: job_id

fields.help_en:
The dependency type. Valid values:

AfterSucceeded: All subtasks of the dependent job or array job succeed. The exit code is 0.
AfterFailed: All subtasks of the dependent job or array job fail. The exit code is not 0.
AfterAny: The dependent job completes (succeeds or fails).
AfterCorresponding: The subtask corresponding to the dependent array job succeeds. The exit code is 0.

Default value: AfterSucceeded
fields.help_zh:
依赖类型。取值范围：

AfterSucceeded：所依赖作业或数组作业所有子任务运行成功（退出码为0）。
AfterFailed：所依赖作业或数组作业任一子任务运行失败（退出码非0）。
AfterAny：所依赖作业运行结束（成功或失败）。
AfterCorresponding：所依赖数组作业对应的子任务运行成功（退出码为0）。

默认值：AfterSucceeded
fields.name: type

parameters.help_en: The dependencies of the serverless job
parameters.name: depends_on

fields.help_en: The number of retries for the serverless job. Valid values: 1 to 10
fields.help_zh: Serverless作业重试次数。取值范围：1～10
fields.name: attempts

fields.help_en:
The job action. Valid values:

Retry: The job starts a retry when a specific exit code is hit.
Exit: The job exits when a specific exit code is hit
fields.help_zh:
作业行为。取值范围如下：

Retry：当命中特定退出码时，作业开始新一轮重试。

Exit：当命中特定退出码时，作业退出
fields.name: action

fields.help_en: The job exit code, which is used together with Action to form a job retry rule. Valid values: 0 to 255
fields.help_zh: 作业退出码，配合Action构成作业重试规则。取值范围：0～255
fields.name: on_exit_code

fields.help_en: The retry rules for the serverless job. You can specify up to 10 rules
fields.help_zh: Serverless作业重试规则列表。最多10个
fields.name: evaluate_on_exit

parameters.help_en: The retry policy of the serverless job
parameters.name: retry_strategy

JobId.description_en: The ID of the serverless job
